info.title: MyGPT VPS Root Shell
info.description: A deliberately minimal Custom GPT Action that exposes one authenticated host-side root shell command runner through Cloudflare Tunnel. Use runCommand for repository work, gh, git, apt, systemctl, modal, kaggle, builds, deployments, file edits, downloads, scripting and general VPS administration.

post.summary: Run any command on the VPS as root
post.description: Runs /bin/bash -lc directly on the VPS host. The systemd service runs as root. This is the universal action: use shell commands and installed CLIs such as gh, git, apt/apt-get, systemctl, modal, kaggle, curl, python, node and arbitrary scripts. Commands may read/write anywhere the root account can access. Output is capped and execution is timeout-limited.

command.description: Shell command or multiline shell script to execute with /bin/bash -lc

workdir.description: Optional host working directory. Absolute paths are supported. Defaults to the service working directory.

timeout_seconds.description: Optional timeout for this command, capped by COMMAND_TIMEOUT_SECONDS

200.description: Command finished; inspect exit_code, stdout, stderr, timed_out and truncated

500.description: Command could not be started or workdir is unavailable
